---
title: "MSBA Course Preference Segmentation"
subtitle: "K-Means, Hierarchical Clustering, and Latent Class MaxDiff"
format:
  revealjs:
    theme: white
    width: 1600
    height: 900
    margin: 0.04
    center: false
    slide-number: true
    embed-resources: true
    transition: none
    title-slide-attributes:
      data-background-color: "#1560a8"

    include-in-header:
      text: |
        <style>
        /* ── Base ─────────────────────────────────────────── */
        .reveal { font-size: 26px; }
        .reveal h2 {
          color: #1560a8;
          font-size: 1.28em;
          margin: 0 0 0.2em 0;
          border-bottom: 3px solid #1560a8;
          padding-bottom: 0.12em;

        .reveal .title-slide h1,
        .reveal .title-slide .title   { color: white !important; }
        .reveal .title-slide .subtitle { color: rgba(255,255,255,0.85) !important; }

        /* ── Images ───────────────────────────────────────── */
        .reveal img {
          display: block;
          max-width: 100%;
          height: auto;
          object-fit: contain;
        }

        /* ── Bullets ──────────────────────────────────────── */
        .reveal ul { margin: 0.25em 0; padding-left: 1.1em; }
        .reveal ul li { margin-bottom: 0.18em; line-height: 1.35; font-size: 0.86em; }

        /* ── k=3 callout ──────────────────────────────────── */
        .k3-box {
          background: #e8f0fd;
          border-left: 4px solid #1560a8;
          border-radius: 0 6px 6px 0;
          padding: 0.35em 0.8em;
          margin-top: 0.4em;
          font-size: 0.82em;
          color: #1560a8;
          font-weight: 600;
        }

        /* ── Segment colours (inline spans) ──────────────── */
        .seg-a { color: #4C72B0; font-weight: 700; }
        .seg-b { color: #55A868; font-weight: 700; }
        .seg-c { color: #DD8452; font-weight: 700; }

        /* ── Definition boxes (slides 3 & 5) ─────────────── */
        .def-box {
          border-radius: 7px;
          padding: 0.65em 0.8em 0.55em;
          font-size: 0.8em;
          line-height: 1.45;
        }
        .def-box .box-title {
          font-weight: 700;
          font-size: 1.05em;
          margin-bottom: 0.3em;
        }
        .def-box p { margin: 0.12em 0; }
        /* per-cluster colours */
        .box-a { border-top: 4px solid #4C72B0; background: #f0f4ff; }
        .box-b { border-top: 4px solid #55A868; background: #f0fff4; }
        .box-c { border-top: 4px solid #DD8452; background: #fff8f0; }
        .box-a .box-title { color: #4C72B0; }
        .box-b .box-title { color: #2e7d52; }
        .box-c .box-title { color: #b05a1a; }
        /* per-LC colours (mirror cluster colours) */

        .box-lc2 .box-title { color: #b05a1a; }

        .cmptbl tr:nth-child(even) td { background: #f4f7ff; }

          font-weight: 700;

          white-space: nowrap;
        }

        /* ── Slide 2 grid ─────────────────────────────────── */
        .k-slide-grid {
          display: grid;
          grid-template-columns: 38% 62%;
          grid-template-rows: auto 110px;
          gap: 0.4em 0.8em;
          height: 760px;
        }
        .k-left { grid-column: 1; grid-row: 1; display: flex; flex-direction: column; gap: 0.3em; }
        .k-pca  { grid-column: 2; grid-row: 1; }
        .k-note {
          grid-column: 1 / 3;
          grid-row: 2;
          font-size: 0.7em;
          padding: 0.55em 0.9em;
          line-height: 1.45;
          background: #f4f7ff;
          border-top: 2px solid #c3d5f5;
          border-radius: 6px;
          align-self: end;
        }
        .k-note strong { color: #1560a8; }
        .k-left img, .k-pca img {
          width: 100%;
          object-fit: contain;
          display: block;
        }
        .k-left img { max-height: 220px; }
        .k-left img:last-child { max-height: 300px; }
        .k-pca  img { max-height: 520px; }
        </style>
        <script>
        document.addEventListener('DOMContentLoaded', function() {
          var secs = document.querySelectorAll('.reveal .slides > section');
          if (secs.length < 2) return;
          var phantom = secs[1];
          if (!phantom || phantom.querySelector('h2')) return;
          var img = phantom.querySelector('img');
          var titleSlide = secs[0];
          if (!img || !titleSlide) return;
          var wrap = document.createElement('div');
          wrap.style.cssText = 'text-align:center;margin-top:0.9em;';
          img.style.cssText = 'display:inline-block;width:50%;max-height:380px;object-fit:contain;border-radius:8px;box-shadow:0 4px 20px rgba(0,0,0,0.28);';
          wrap.appendChild(img);
          titleSlide.appendChild(wrap);
          phantom.parentNode.removeChild(phantom);
          if (typeof Reveal !== 'undefined' && typeof Reveal.sync === 'function') {
            Reveal.sync();
          }
        });
        </script>
---

## Choosing k = 3

<div class="k-slide-grid">
<div class="k-left">
![](clustering_outputs/elbow_10course_only.png)
![](clustering_outputs/silhouette_10course_only.png)
</div>
<div class="k-pca">
![](clustering_outputs/pca_scatter_10course_abc_only.png)
</div>
<div class="k-note">
<strong>Elbow:</strong> look for where inertia improvement slows.
<strong>Silhouette:</strong> higher is better, but interpretability and balanced segment sizes also matter.
<strong>k = 3 is chosen</strong> because it is interpretable and balanced.
<strong>PCA</strong> shows clusters overlap softly, so structure is real but not sharp.
</div>
</div>

## Hierarchical Clustering: Validation

::: {.columns}

::: {.column width="34%"}
![Dendrogram — Ward linkage, cut at k = 3.](clustering_outputs/dendrogram_10course_only.png){width="100%" style="max-height:510px;object-fit:contain;"}
:::

::: {.column width="66%"}
![HC cluster centers — same three preference profiles emerge from a different algorithm.](clustering_outputs/hc_centers_named.png){width="100%" style="max-height:510px;object-fit:contain;"}
:::

:::

::: {.bottom-band}
Hierarchical clustering gives a robustness check using Ward linkage. It recovers a similar three-segment structure to k-means. <span class="ari">ARI vs K-Means = 0.70</span>
:::


## Latent Class MaxDiff: Validation

![LC-MNL K = 3 class utilities. Three classes with distinct preference patterns — LC 1, LC 2, LC 3.](clustering_outputs/lc_utilities_k3.png){width="92%" style="max-height:415px;object-fit:contain;margin:0 auto;"}

::: {.fragment .fade-up .bottom-band fragment-index=1}
::: {.columns}
::: {.column width="50%"}
**What it is:** A probabilistic choice model estimated directly from the original best/worst survey responses. It estimates class-specific course utilities and assigns each student to a latent class — no derived scores needed.
:::
::: {.column width="50%"}
**Why it validates:** Uses raw MaxDiff choices rather than derived preference scores. If it recovers similar groups, that strengthens confidence in the K-Means segments. &nbsp;<span class="ari">ARI vs K-Means = 0.69</span>
:::
:::
:::

## Model Comparison

<table class="cmptbl">
<thead>
<tr>
  <th style="width:14%">Model</th>
  <th style="width:17%">Input Used</th>
  <th style="width:15%">What It Optimizes</th>
  <th style="width:18%">Strength</th>
  <th style="width:18%">Limitation</th>
  <th style="width:18%">Segment Story</th>
</tr>
</thead>
<tbody>
<tr>
  <td>K-Means</td>
  <td>Per-student preference scores<br>(best − worst ÷ times shown)</td>
  <td>Minimize within-cluster variance</td>
  <td>Fast; cluster centers directly interpretable in original preference score units</td>
  <td>Tends to produce similarly-sized groups; k must be chosen before fitting</td>
  <td>
    <span class="seg-a">A</span> — Mktg Analytics &amp; Big Data (31)<br>
    <span class="seg-b">B</span> — Applied Analytics Seekers (29)<br>
    <span class="seg-c">C</span> — Quant &amp; Technical (25)
  </td>
</tr>
<tr>
  <td>Hierarchical Clustering</td>
  <td>Same preference scores</td>
  <td>Minimise variance at each successive merge step (Ward linkage)</td>
  <td>No k required upfront; dendrogram reveals similarity between groups</td>
  <td>Students cannot be reassigned after a merge; borderline cases may differ from K-Means</td>
  <td><span class="match">Same 3 groups · ARI = 0.70</span><br>7 in 10 students assigned identically</td>
</tr>
<tr>
  <td>Latent Class MaxDiff</td>
  <td>Raw best/worst choice tasks from the survey</td>
  <td>Maximise choice log-likelihood via EM; class utilities from actual responses</td>
  <td>Uses original survey data directly; most appropriate method for MaxDiff design; fit statistics guide K selection</td>
  <td>K = 3 and K = 4 nearly tied in fit (ΔBIC &lt; 1); results depend on random starting values</td>
  <td><span class="match">Same 3 groups · ARI = 0.69</span><br>Three classes mirror K-Means segments</td>
</tr>
</tbody>
</table>
